<h2>Get New Targets Errors</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Compares 'targets' error metadata before and after a pipeline run and
returns errors newly recorded or retried by that run.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>extract_new_target_errors(data_errors_before = NULL, data_errors_after = NULL)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_errors_before">data_errors_before</code></td>
<td>
<p>Error metadata captured before execution.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_errors_after">data_errors_after</code></td>
<td>
<p>Error metadata captured after execution.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A tibble of new error records with 'name', 'error', and 'time' columns.
</p>

</main>
